name: Digital Samba
description_en:
Digital Samba has two product paths: a free browser meeting service for end users and Digital Samba Embedded for developers adding video calls to their own software. The same vendor supplies both, but branding, API integration and usage pricing belong to the Embedded offer.

The free service can start an instant call or generate a shareable meeting link without signup. Advanced account scheduling is described as beta. End-to-end encryption is an explicit option with feature trade-offs, not a label to apply indiscriminately to every interaction.
description_zh:
Digital Samba 有两条产品路径：供终端用户使用的免费浏览器会议，以及供开发者在自有软件中加入视频的 Digital Samba Embedded。两者由同一厂商提供，但品牌、API 集成及用量价格属于 Embedded。

免费服务可不注册直接开会或生成分享链接，高级账户排程被标为 beta。端到端加密是有功能取舍的明确选项，不能不加区分地用于所有互动。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from attached official sources. Product behavior is vendor-documented, not independently tested.
All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.en:
For an ordinary client discussion, generate a meeting link, share it privately and have participants grant the required camera/microphone permissions. The homepage says links stay active for about a month. If enabling E2EE, note the explicit exclusions: Q&A, polling, shared notes and saving whiteboards are disabled. Evaluate the actual collaboration task with encryption selected; do not promise both mutually incompatible modes.

For an embedded application, use the SDK for client events/commands and the REST API for server-side room management. The documentation examples are implementation aids, not evidence that your application has correct access control.
sections.zh:
普通客户讨论可生成链接、私下分享，并由参与者授权所需摄像头/麦克风。首页表示链接约一个月有效。开启 E2EE 时应注意明确排除项：问答、投票、共享笔记及保存白板被关闭。应在选择加密后评估实际协作任务，不能同时承诺互斥模式。

嵌入应用可通过 SDK 处理客户端事件/命令，REST API 负责服务端房间管理。文档示例是实施帮助，不证明你的应用访问控制已正确。

sections.title_en: Free calls and billable participation minutes
sections.title_zh: 免费通话与计费参与分钟
sections.en:
The Free SaaS offer is listed at €0. Embedded is usage-based with a headline as low as €0.0026 per minute depending on volume, and a developer free tier of 10,000 participation minutes monthly. The minimum headline is not a universal rate. Recording, white label/CNAME and support also affect pricing.

Two participants connected for thirty minutes represent sixty participation minutes as an illustrative budgeting model; confirm exact metering and rates in the full offer. A free developer allowance does not establish unlimited commercial use or self-hosting rights.
sections.zh:
Free SaaS 标价 €0。Embedded 按用量计费，宣传依用量最低每分钟 €0.0026，并为开发者提供每月 10,000 参与分钟免费档。最低宣传费率不是统一费率；录制、白标/CNAME 及支持也影响费用。

按预算示例，两人各连接三十分钟为六十参与分钟；具体计量与费率需完整报价确认。开发免费额度不能证明商业用量不限或具备自托管权。

sections.title_en: Choose the hosted call or integration path
sections.title_zh: 选择托管通话或集成路径
sections.en:
A nontechnical host can evaluate Free; a team building in-app consultation should evaluate Embedded and budget engineering. Before use, check browser devices, guest access and recording consent. After a connection failure, distinguish joining the room from receiving media and saving shared artifacts. No call, encryption, SDK, recording or recovery was tested.

The site describes European hosting and privacy commitments, which remain vendor statements here. No complete subprocessors/contract audit or component licence review was performed. Free use does not establish open-source software or a self-hosted distribution.
sections.zh:
非技术主持人可评估 Free，开发应用内咨询的团队应评估 Embedded 并预算工程工作。使用前检查浏览器设备、访客访问及录制同意。连接失败后，应区分进入房间、接收媒体与保存共享资料。本次未测试通话、加密、SDK、录制或恢复。

网站介绍欧洲托管及隐私承诺，本文仍将其视为厂商陈述，未完整审查子处理商/合同或组件许可。免费使用不能证明软件开源或有自托管发行版。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: No call/E2EE/API or restoration test; exact embedded rate tiers, recording costs, component licences and contract residency need confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试通话/E2EE/API 或恢复；具体嵌入费率档、录制费、组件许可及合同驻留需确认。
